# Introduction

Deck-restructure keystone (edge 3 / analysis A2): **does morphology encode cell
state?** Holding cell type constant, we ask whether OPC-lineage, astrocyte, and
myeloid cells upregulate a **glycan-ECM program** in their ENVI-imputed
transcriptome when they sit in **loose (myxoid)** vs **compact (fibrillary)**
pathology regions. Myxoid = a glycan-rich matrix, so *driver → glycan/secretory
state → myxoid morphology* would close the biphasic-PA loop.

The ENVI objects are here: `data/sc_integration/ENVI_results_091126`.

**How to read the results:**

- **Inferential unit = sample, n = 3.** Each patient contributes one *pseudobulk*
  mean per region, so the contrast is 3 compact vs 3 loose per cell type — cell-rich
  patients cannot dominate. Sample 258482 has **no compact annotation** and drops
  everywhere (usable: 188570, 320784, 328368).
- **Two complementary readouts, reported together:** (i) unbiased preranked GSEA over
  all ~7,880 MSigDB sets (FDR is BH-adjusted across the *entire* collection, then we
  filter to glycan/ECM sets for display), and (ii) a curated 34-gene glycan-ECM score
  read as **per-patient direction (x/3) + effect**. A result is "robust" only when
  both agree.
- **Effect sizes are small by construction** — `score_genes` is background-subtracted,
  and ENVI imputation shrinks expression toward the conditional mean (attenuating
  magnitudes). The rank-based **NES** and per-patient direction, not the raw delta, are
  the effect readouts.
- **The glycan axis is partly definitional** (myxoid *is* glycan-rich matrix) — so a hit
  is confirmatory. The compact/myxoid transcriptional shift is also *broad* (many sets
  move), so we focus on a **curated matrix-glycan panel** with a coherent biosynthesis-up
  / catabolism-down pattern rather than on raw significance. Labels are broad lineages
  (tumor identity proxy-based); imputed state is bounded by the 266-gene panel. (A SASP
  axis was examined and dropped: curated-only, not GSEA-corroborated.)

# Consistent semantic colors reused across every figure.
REGION_COLORS = {"compact": "#4C72B0", "loose": "#C44E52"}   # compact=blue, myxoid=red
UP_DOWN = {"up": "#C44E52", "down": "#4C72B0"}
# FDR significance tiers (RdBu reds; grey = not significant).
TIER_ORDER = ["q < 0.05", "q < 0.25", "n.s. (q ≥ 0.25)"]
TIER_COLORS = {"q < 0.05": "#b2182b", "q < 0.25": "#ef8a62", "n.s. (q ≥ 0.25)": "#cfcfcf"}

def fdr_tier(padj):
    if padj < 0.05:
        return "q < 0.05"
    if padj < 0.25:
        return "q < 0.25"
    return "n.s. (q ≥ 0.25)"

def fdr_stars(padj):
    return "**" if padj < 0.05 else ("*" if padj < 0.25 else "")

def prettify_set_name(s, maxlen=42):
    # strip the MSigDB source prefix and title-case for a talk audience
    for pre in ["GOBP_", "GOMF_", "GOCC_", "REACTOME_", "KEGG_MEDICUS_", "KEGG_", "WP_", "HALLMARK_"]:
        if s.startswith(pre):
            s = s[len(pre):]
            break
    s = s.replace("_", " ").strip().title()
    # keep common acronyms upper
    for ac in ["Ecm", "Gag", "Hs", "N Glycosylation", "O Glycosylation"]:
        s = s.replace(ac, ac.upper().replace("N GLYCOSYLATION", "N-glycosylation").replace("O GLYCOSYLATION", "O-glycosylation"))
    return s if len(s) <= maxlen else s[: maxlen - 1] + "…"

def short_sample(name):
    # "188570 pilocytic astrocytoma" -> "188570"
    return str(name).split()[0]

# Run (or reuse) the pseudobulk + limma/fgsea pipeline

The heavy lifting lives in a self-contained sibling folder (same pattern as
`CL/morphology_state_gsea/`): `morphology_state_prepare.py` builds sample × region
pseudobulk means per cell type, `morphology_state.R` runs limma (`~ sample + region`,
compact = reference) + preranked fgsea over MSigDB. Cached: the pipeline re-runs only
when its outputs are missing or `FORCE_PIPELINE = True`.

```{python}
pa_dir = Path(workdir) / "youyun/plgg/code/sc_integration/ENVI/2_spatial_imputation/PA"

        if not p.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing pipeline script: {p}")

    cmd_prepare = [sys.executable, str(prepare_path)]
    print("Running:", " ".join(cmd_prepare))
    run_prepare = subprocess.run(cmd_prepare, capture_output=True, text=True)

    if run_prepare.returncode != 0:

        cmd_r = ["conda", "run", "-n", "spatial", "Rscript", str(rscript_path)]

        raise RuntimeError("Neither Rscript nor conda executable is available.")
    print("Running:", " ".join(cmd_r))
    run_r = subprocess.run(cmd_r, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(run_r.stdout)
    if run_r.returncode != 0:
        print(run_r.stderr)

else:

# How broad is the compact-vs-myxoid shift? (context for the p-values)

Before reading glycan significance, gauge the background: of *all* ~7,880 tested sets,
how many are significant (FDR is BH-adjusted across the whole collection). If a large
fraction of the genome is significant, "glycan is significant" is weak on its own.

```{python}
# Global significance across ALL sets (loose > compact) per cell type.
# NB: name this gsea_lc, NOT glob — `glob` is the imported module used below.
gsea_lc = gsea_results[gsea_results["contrast"] == "loose > compact"].copy()
glob_tab = (gsea_lc.groupby("cell_type")
    .agg(n_sets=("padj", "size"),
         pct_raw_p_lt_0p05=("pval", lambda x: round(100 * (x < 0.05).mean(), 1)),
         n_q_lt_0p05=("padj", lambda x: int((x < 0.05).sum())),
         n_q_lt_0p25=("padj", lambda x: int((x < 0.25).sum())))
    .reindex(CELL_TYPES))
glob_tab.index = [lineage_display[c] for c in glob_tab.index]
print("Across ALL MSigDB sets (loose > compact); chance ~5% at raw p<0.05:")
glob_tab
```

The compact/myxoid difference is **broad** (myeloid: ~27% of all sets at raw p<0.05,
≫ 5%) — expected for two very different niches. So we do not rest on "glycan is
significant." We rest on (i) glycan genes sitting near the **top** of the genome-wide
shift (see effect-in-context below) and (ii) the **curated, biologically-coherent**
pattern next.

# Curated matrix-glycan / ECM enrichment

The broad keyword theme mixes genuine matrix biology (proteoglycans, GAG/heparan/
chondroitin/dermatan-sulfate, ECM organization) with generic protein-glycosylation sets
(N-/O-glycan, "glycosyl compound metabolism") that are not myxoid-matrix and move
inconsistently. Here we restrict to a **curated matrix-glycan panel**, grouped by biology.
NES > 0 = up in myxoid; `**` q<0.05, `*` q<0.25. The pattern is a net **matrix
accumulation** signature: biosynthesis / structure up, catabolism down.

```{python}
# Curated, focused matrix-glycan / ECM sets (subset of the keyword theme), grouped so the
# myxoid pattern is legible. All were tested genome-wide; we just select + arrange them.
CURATED_SETS = {
    "GAG / proteoglycan biosynthesis & ECM structure": [
        "REACTOME_ECM_PROTEOGLYCANS",
        "REACTOME_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX_ORGANIZATION",
        "GOBP_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX_ASSEMBLY",
        "GOBP_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX_CONSTITUENT_SECRETION",
        "KEGG_ECM_RECEPTOR_INTERACTION",
        "GOBP_PROTEOGLYCAN_BIOSYNTHETIC_PROCESS",
        "REACTOME_HEPARAN_SULFATE_HEPARIN_HS_GAG_METABOLISM",
        "KEGG_GLYCOSAMINOGLYCAN_BIOSYNTHESIS_HEPARAN_SULFATE",
        "REACTOME_CHONDROITIN_SULFATE_DERMATAN_SULFATE_METABOLISM",
        "REACTOME_DERMATAN_SULFATE_BIOSYNTHESIS",
        "REACTOME_CHONDROITIN_SULFATE_BIOSYNTHESIS",
        "REACTOME_GLYCOSAMINOGLYCAN_METABOLISM",
    ],
    "GAG / proteoglycan catabolism (degradation)": [
        "GOBP_PROTEOGLYCAN_CATABOLIC_PROCESS",
        "GOBP_GLYCOSAMINOGLYCAN_CATABOLIC_PROCESS",
        "WP_GLYCOSAMINOGLYCAN_DEGRADATION",
        "KEGG_GLYCOSAMINOGLYCAN_DEGRADATION",
    ],
}

# Assemble NES + FDR for each curated set x cell type (loose > compact).
rows = []
for group, sets in CURATED_SETS.items():
    for s in sets:
        for ct in CELL_TYPES:
            r = gsea_lc[(gsea_lc["cell_type"] == ct) & (gsea_lc["set_name"] == s)]
            rows.append({
                "group": group, "set_name": s, "cell_type": ct,
                "NES": float(r["NES"].iloc[0]) if len(r) else np.nan,
                "padj": float(r["padj"].iloc[0]) if len(r) else np.nan,
            })
cur = pd.DataFrame(rows)
cur["ct_disp"] = cur["cell_type"].map(lineage_display)
cur["label"] = cur["set_name"].map(prettify_set_name)

# Row order: biosynthesis block then catabolism block; record group boundaries.
row_order, group_spans, cursor = [], [], 0
for group, sets in CURATED_SETS.items():
    labs = [prettify_set_name(s) for s in sets]
    row_order += labs
    group_spans.append((group, cursor, cursor + len(labs)))
    cursor += len(labs)

nes_mat = cur.pivot_table(index="label", columns="ct_disp", values="NES").reindex(index=row_order, columns=ct_order)
padj_mat = cur.pivot_table(index="label", columns="ct_disp", values="padj").reindex(index=row_order, columns=ct_order)
star_mat = padj_mat.applymap(lambda p: "**" if (pd.notna(p) and p < 0.05) else ("*" if (pd.notna(p) and p < 0.25) else ""))

# short right-edge group tags (colorbar moved to the bottom, so no overlap)
GROUP_SHORT = {
    "GAG / proteoglycan biosynthesis & ECM structure": "Biosynthesis / ECM structure  ↑",
    "GAG / proteoglycan catabolism (degradation)": "Catabolism  ↓",
}
# Transposed layout: programs (gene sets) on x-axis, cell types on y-axis.
nes_t = nes_mat.T.reindex(index=ct_order, columns=row_order)
star_t = star_mat.T.reindex(index=ct_order, columns=row_order)
nrows_h, ncol_h = nes_t.shape
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(0.85 * ncol_h + 3.0, 0.62 * nrows_h + 4.6))
sns.heatmap(nes_t, ax=ax, cmap="RdBu_r", center=0, vmin=-2.2, vmax=2.2,
            annot=star_t.values, fmt="", annot_kws={"fontsize": 18, "fontweight": "bold", "color": "black"},
            linewidths=0.6, linecolor="white", cbar_kws={"label": "NES  (→ up in myxoid)", "shrink": 0.7})
# vertical divider between the biosynthesis and catabolism column blocks
for _, start, end in group_spans[:-1]:
    ax.vlines(end, 0, nrows_h, color="black", lw=2.5)
# group labels in a band just above the heatmap (title sits higher via pad)
trans = ax.get_xaxis_transform()
for group, start, end in group_spans:
    ax.text((start + end) / 2, 1.02, GROUP_SHORT[group], transform=trans,
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=15, fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlabel(""); ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_xticklabels(nes_t.columns, rotation=40, ha="right", fontsize=13)
ax.set_yticklabels(nes_t.index, rotation=0, fontsize=18)
ax.set_title("Curated matrix-glycan / ECM enrichment: myxoid vs compact    ** q<0.05   * q<0.25",
             fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", pad=48)
fig.savefig(fig_dir / "fig_gsea_curated_matrix_glycan.png")
plt.show()
```

cur_sig["direction"] = np.where(cur_sig["NES"] > 0, "up in myxoid", "down in myxoid")
print(f"Curated matrix-glycan sets with FDR<0.25 (loose>compact): {cur_sig.shape[0]} rows")
(cur_sig.sort_values(["group", "ct_disp", "padj"])
        [["group", "ct_disp", "label", "NES", "padj", "direction"]]

# Curated glycan-ECM score: per-patient compact → myxoid

The 34-gene glycan-ECM panel (proteoglycans, hyaluronan synthases, GAG/glycosylation
enzymes), scored per cell with `sc.tl.score_genes` (background-subtracted), then averaged
to one value per patient×region. The claim rests on **per-patient direction (x/3)**, not
the raw delta magnitude. Cached to TSV — recompute with `FORCE_SCORING = True`.

```{python}
GLYCAN_ECM_GENES = [
    "HAS1", "HAS2", "HAS3", "HAPLN1", "HAPLN2",
    "VCAN", "BCAN", "ACAN", "NCAN", "LUM",
    "SPOCK1", "SPOCK2", "SPOCK3", "BGN", "DCN", "FMOD", "PRELP",
    "SDC1", "SDC2", "GPC3", "TNC", "FN1", "SPP1",
    "CHSY1", "CHPF", "CSGALNACT1", "XYLT1",
    "B3GNT2", "B4GALT1", "MGAT5", "ST6GAL1", "ST3GAL1", "FUT8", "GALNT1",
]

FORCE_SCORING = False
means_cache = ms_dir / "morphology_state_glycan_score_means.tsv"
gene_cache = ms_dir / "morphology_state_glycan_gene_means.tsv"

# Metadata + h5ad list are cheap; only the h5ad *reads* are heavy and cache-gated.
cell_meta = pd.read_csv(
    workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/xenium_cell_types/cell_metadata_resct0.2_resni0.5_20260826.tsv",
    sep="\t", usecols=["cell_id", "cell_type", "pathology_annotation"]
).set_index("cell_id")
cell_meta["region"] = cell_meta["pathology_annotation"].map(REGION_MAP)

data_root = None
for cand in ["youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results_091126"]:
    if (Path(workdir) / cand).exists():
        data_root = Path(workdir) / cand
        break
spatial_files = sorted(glob.glob(str(data_root / "*astrocytoma_spatial_envi.h5ad")))

if not FORCE_SCORING and means_cache.exists() and gene_cache.exists():
    sig_means = pd.read_csv(means_cache, sep="\t")
    gene_means = pd.read_csv(gene_cache, sep="\t")
    print("Loaded cached glycan score/gene means (set FORCE_SCORING=True to recompute).")
else:
    print(f"Scoring glycan-ECM on {len(spatial_files)} h5ads (heavy)...")
    score_rows, gene_rows = [], []
    for f in spatial_files:
        sample_name = re.sub("_spatial_envi.h5ad$", "", Path(f).name).replace("_", " ")
        adata = sc.read(f)
        # obsm['imputation'] columns are the ~18k imputed genes (NOT the 266 var_names).
        imp = adata.obsm["imputation"]
        if isinstance(imp, pd.DataFrame):
            genes = pd.Index(imp.columns).astype(str).str.upper(); X = imp.to_numpy()
        else:
            genes = pd.Index(adata.var_names).astype(str).str.upper(); X = np.asarray(imp)
        keep = ~genes.duplicated(keep="first"); genes = genes[keep]; X = X[:, keep]

        impute = ad.AnnData(X=X); impute.var_names = genes
        obs_names = pd.Index(adata.obs_names)
        ct_vec = obs_names.map(cell_meta["cell_type"]).to_numpy()
        reg_vec = obs_names.map(cell_meta["region"]).to_numpy()
        impute.obs["cell_type"] = ct_vec
        impute.obs["region"] = reg_vec

        present = [g for g in GLYCAN_ECM_GENES if g in set(genes)]
        sc.tl.score_genes(impute, gene_list=present, score_name="glycan_ecm_score", use_raw=False)

        # (a) per patient x cell_type x region mean score
        obs = impute.obs
        keep_cells = obs["cell_type"].isin(CELL_TYPES) & obs["region"].isin(["compact", "loose"])
        for (ct, reg), grp in obs[keep_cells].groupby(["cell_type", "region"]):
            score_rows.append({"sample": sample_name, "cell_type": ct, "region": reg,
                               "n_cells": len(grp), "glycan_ecm_score": float(grp["glycan_ecm_score"].mean())})

        # (b) per-gene mean imputed expression (same h5ad pass -> no extra loads)
        gidx = genes.get_indexer(present)
        for ct in CELL_TYPES:
            for reg in ["compact", "loose"]:
                mask = (ct_vec == ct) & (reg_vec == reg)
                if mask.sum() < MIN_CELLS:
                    continue
                means = np.nanmean(X[np.ix_(mask, gidx)], axis=0)
                for gname, m in zip(present, means):
                    gene_rows.append({"sample": sample_name, "cell_type": ct, "region": reg,
                                      "gene": gname, "mean_expr": float(m)})

    sig_means = pd.DataFrame(score_rows)
    gene_means = pd.DataFrame(gene_rows)
    sig_means.to_csv(means_cache, sep="\t", index=False)
    gene_means.to_csv(gene_cache, sep="\t", index=False)
    print(f"Cached: {len(sig_means)} score rows, {len(gene_means)} gene rows.")
```

```{python}
# Per-patient loose - compact delta (only pairs clearing the gate in BOTH regions).
wide = sig_means.pivot_table(index=["sample", "cell_type"], columns="region",
                             values=["glycan_ecm_score", "n_cells"], aggfunc="first")
rows = []
for (sample, ct), r in wide.iterrows():
    n_c, n_l = r.get(("n_cells", "compact"), np.nan), r.get(("n_cells", "loose"), np.nan)
    if not (n_c >= MIN_CELLS and n_l >= MIN_CELLS):
        continue
    s_c, s_l = r[("glycan_ecm_score", "compact")], r[("glycan_ecm_score", "loose")]
    rows.append({"sample": sample, "cell_type": ct, "score_compact": s_c, "score_loose": s_l,
                 "delta_loose_minus_compact": s_l - s_c, "n_compact": int(n_c), "n_loose": int(n_l)})
deltas = pd.DataFrame(rows)
deltas["cell_type_disp"] = deltas["cell_type"].map(lambda c: lineage_display.get(c, c))

summary = (deltas.groupby(["cell_type"])
           .agg(n_samples=("delta_loose_minus_compact", "size"),
                n_up=("delta_loose_minus_compact", lambda x: int((x > 0).sum())),
                mean_delta=("delta_loose_minus_compact", "mean")).reset_index())
summary["cell_type_disp"] = summary["cell_type"].map(lambda c: lineage_display.get(c, c))
# best curated matrix-glycan GSEA FDR per cell type, to annotate the per-patient plot
best_q = cur.groupby("cell_type")["padj"].min()
summary["best_glycan_gsea_q"] = summary["cell_type"].map(best_q)

deltas.to_csv(ms_dir / "morphology_state_curated_signature_deltas.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
summary.to_csv(ms_dir / "morphology_state_curated_signature_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
summary[["cell_type_disp", "n_samples", "n_up", "mean_delta", "best_glycan_gsea_q"]]
```

## Effect size in context

The per-patient delta is small in *absolute* terms, but that is not a scoring artifact:
the raw glycan-panel expression delta ≈ the background-subtracted score delta (so
`score_genes` is not squishing the group difference), and the panel sits near the **top**
of the genome-wide shift. Small magnitude reflects ENVI shrinkage + only part of the panel
moving, not a wrong signal.

```{python}
# (i) raw glycan panel delta vs score delta; (ii) where the glycan panel's mean logFC
# falls within the genome-wide loose-vs-compact shift (percentile).
paired_samples = set(deltas["sample"])
gmp = gene_means[gene_means["sample"].isin(paired_samples)]
eic = []
for ct in CELL_TYPES:
    sub = gmp[gmp["cell_type"] == ct]
    piv = sub.pivot_table(index=["gene", "sample"], columns="region", values="mean_expr")
    raw_delta = (piv["loose"] - piv["compact"]).mean()
    score_delta = deltas.loc[deltas["cell_type"] == ct, "delta_loose_minus_compact"].mean()
    d = limma_de[limma_de["cell_type"] == ct]
    gd = d[d["gene"].isin(GLYCAN_ECM_GENES)]
    glymean = gd["logFC_loose_vs_compact"].mean()
    pct = 100 * (d["logFC_loose_vs_compact"] < glymean).mean()
    eic.append({
        "cell_type": lineage_display[ct],
        "raw_panel_delta": round(raw_delta, 4),
        "score_delta": round(score_delta, 4),
        "n_genes_up_of_34": int((gd["logFC_loose_vs_compact"] > 0).sum()),
        "panel_logFC_genome_percentile": round(pct, 0),
    })
pd.DataFrame(eic)
```

```{python}

# Glycan-ECM gene expression: compact vs myxoid, per patient

Mean imputed expression of the panel genes, z-scored per gene across patient×region
columns. Columns grouped by region (compact block | myxoid block) so a consistent
red-shift in the myxoid block reads directly.

```{python}
# restrict to the 3 paired patients so compact|myxoid blocks are symmetric
gm = gene_means[gene_means["sample"].isin(set(deltas["sample"]))].copy()
gm["sample_short"] = gm["sample"].map(short_sample)
gm["col"] = gm["sample_short"] + " · " + gm["region"]

n_ct = len(CELL_TYPES)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_ct, figsize=(6.4 * n_ct, 11), squeeze=False)
for ax, ct in zip(axes[0], CELL_TYPES):
    sub = gm[gm["cell_type"] == ct]
    mat = sub.pivot_table(index="gene", columns="col", values="mean_expr", aggfunc="mean")
    # order columns: all compact then all loose; z-score per gene
    comp_cols = sorted([c for c in mat.columns if c.endswith("compact")])
    loose_cols = sorted([c for c in mat.columns if c.endswith("loose")])
    cols = comp_cols + loose_cols
    mat = mat[cols]
    z = mat.sub(mat.mean(axis=1), axis=0).div(mat.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0)
    # order genes by myxoid-minus-compact mean z (most myxoid-up on top)
    order = (z[loose_cols].mean(axis=1) - z[comp_cols].mean(axis=1)).sort_values(ascending=False).index
    z = z.reindex(order)
    hm = sns.heatmap(z, ax=ax, cmap="vlag", center=0, vmin=-1.5, vmax=1.5,
                     cbar=(ct == CELL_TYPES[-1]), cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.4, "label": "z-score"},
                     linewidths=0.3, linecolor="white")
    ax.axvline(len(comp_cols), color="black", lw=2)  # compact | myxoid divider
    ax.set_title(lineage_display.get(ct, ct))
    ax.set_xlabel(""); ax.set_ylabel("")
    ax.set_xticklabels([c.replace(" · compact", "\ncompact").replace(" · loose", "\nmyxoid")
                        for c in cols], fontsize=12, rotation=0)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=11)
fig.suptitle("Glycan-ECM panel genes  ·  compact | myxoid  (z per gene; sorted by myxoid enrichment)",
             y=1.02, fontsize=19, fontweight="bold")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(fig_dir / "fig_glycan_gene_heatmap.png")
plt.show()
```

# Notes

- **3-vs-3 paired pseudobulk.** Per cell type, limma fits `~ sample + region` on 3
  compact + 3 loose patient means (compact = reference); fgsea ranks all 18,077 genes by
  the moderated *t*. Patients are weighted equally, so no single patient dominates.
- **Two readouts, reported together.** Curated matrix-glycan GSEA (biosynthesis/structure
  UP, catabolism DOWN = net matrix accumulation) + curated 34-gene score (per-patient
  direction). The genome-wide compact/myxoid shift is broad (myeloid ~27% of sets at raw
  p<0.05), so the *curated coherence* + glycan's top-percentile position — not raw
  significance — carry the claim.
- **Effect magnitudes are small by construction** (background-subtracted `score_genes` +
  ENVI imputation shrinkage). NES and per-patient direction are the effect readouts, not
  the raw delta. The glycan axis is partly definitional (myxoid = glycan-rich matrix).
- **Caching:** `FORCE_PIPELINE` rebuilds pseudobulk+limma+fgsea; `FORCE_SCORING` rebuilds
  the per-cell scoring from the h5ads. Both default to reusing cached TSVs, so plot edits
  render fast.
- Cell-type display names follow `helpers/cell_type_display.R`
  (`astro_glial`→Astrocytes, `opc`→OPC, `myeloid`→Myeloid).
```
